name: Iwasaki Rumi
source:
Nurse working at Jomiya General Hospital. She is hypersexual. She often touches patients.

She is seen by Sakaguchi when she is serving a patient.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1327]Getchu[/url]]
